propositions: The idempotency test's wall-clock patch at line 311 targets binding_store_mod._now_iso, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and sibling operations to binding_lifecycle.py which resolves its own _now_iso, causing the patch to miss those operations.
The integration oracle's blast radius narrowed after the module relocation: it would no longer catch a regression where clear_absent stamps updated_at unconditionally on an unchanged reconcile pass.

The unit-tier contract test (test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence) pins the no-dirty guarantee directly, but the integration-tier oracle should be restored to cross-validate the end-to-end behavior.
The only binding_store_mod-targeted patch in test_reconcile_idempotency.py whose subject moved is the _now_iso freeze at line 311; other moved operations lack test patches in that file.
